rounds.description: Nine groups. Group winners qualified directly for the 2026 World Cup; the four best runners-up advanced to the CAF playoff. Matches against sixth-place teams were excluded when ranking runners-up because Group E had five active teams after Eritrea withdrew.
The four best runners-up played single-elimination matches in Morocco. DR Congo won and advanced to the inter-confederation playoffs.
CAF playoff winner DR Congo entered the FIFA inter-confederation playoff tournament and qualified by defeating Jamaica after extra time.
